_comment: Repos the weekly upstream watch follows (.github/workflows/upstream-watch.yml). 'reviewed' is the last commit a person or agent has gone through; move it forward when a review is done (see docs/UPSTREAM-WATCH.md).

repos.name: OpenDAoC-Core
repos.note: Our server base. Reviewed through 2026-11-23 in the 2026-11-24 harvest (base was about d51233cb, 2026-03-13).

repos.name: OfflineDAoC-True165
repos.note: shadowofze's current home (True 1.65). GPL-3.0. Bot AI source: its pre-v0.7 bots/ files were mostly never ported. Reviewed in the 2026-11-24 harvest (docs/upstream/HARVEST-2026-11.md, issues #567-#574).

repos.name: DividedRealms
repos.note: GPL-3.0. Same bot lineage as ours; active work is on this branch (main stops at a0555cd, 2026-11-11). Much is ToA/ML/NF, out of era. Reviewed in the 2026-11-24 harvest.

repos.name: DetShaft-LivingServer
repos.note: GPL-3.0. A Living Server fork (their 1.1.x-beta line): player-group combat, siege, pets. Reviewed in the 2026-11-24 harvest.

repos.name: FelixGagnonB-OfflineDAoC
repos.note: GPL-3.0. A 0.37 fork with an engine fix (two singers). Reviewed in the 2026-11-24 harvest.

repos.name: FelixGagnonB-OfflineDAoC-pvp-8v8
repos.note: GPL-3.0. The 8v8 PvP group AI (bots/pvp/). Milestone branches (m2..m11) move on: when the watch can't read this branch, point it at the newest pvp-8v8-m* branch. Reviewed in the 2026-11-24 harvest.
